import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveFormations } from '@src/api/bot/cave-formation-queries';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const layoutCommand = '/储物袋 道具 其它';

  const active = await getBackendCaveFormations(bid, e.uid as number);
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (active.length === 0) {
    md.addText('暂无生效中的洞府阵法');
  } else {
    for (const item of active) {
      const quote = Format.createMarkdown().addText(`【${item.categoryLabel}】${item.formationName}`);

      quote.addText(' ').addButton('替换', { data: `${layoutCommand} 洞府阵法` });
      quote.addText(' ').addButton('移除', { data: `/移除阵法 ${item.formationName}` });
      quote.addNewline().addText(` 剩余 ${item.remainingText} `).addNewline().addText(` ${item.effectText} `);
      md.addBlockquote(quote);
    }
  }

  const footerButtons = [{ label: '背包', command: layoutCommand }];

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '洞府阵法',
      content: md,
      footer: footerButtons
    })
  );
});
